title: The Tropical fruit of the island
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：tropical　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tropical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the driver wrote of ① a tropical fruit of the island in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so tropical that nobody in the station would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the tropical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the tropical fruit of the island that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1966 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too tropical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the tropical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a tropical rain of the season, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as tropical as the rain of the season they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was tropical or not, and he said so.

By 1979 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something tropical, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite tropical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the tropical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1982, at once, she wrote of another tropical fruit of the island in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less tropical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The tropical rain of the season that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1984, was the one she could never quite name; the tropical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 热带（前置定语 a tropical fruit of the island：1972 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件热带的水果）
B. adj. 热带／湿热（两处加强说法：so tropical that … 与 no less tropical than …）
C. adj. 热带／湿热（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 热带（表语 too tropical to do：母亲觉得它太热带，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 湿热（前置定语 a tropical rain of the season：叔叔把整件事称作一桩湿热的雨）
F. adj. 湿热（同级比较 as tropical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩雨季湿热的雨相比）
G. adj. 湿热（后置定语 something tropical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 湿热（受程度副词修饰 quite tropical：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a tropical fruit of the island
the tropical fruit of the island that
a tropical rain of the season
The tropical rain of the season that

answers.why: tropical 意为“热带”，1972 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件热带的水果”，此处作前置定语 a tropical fruit of the island。
tropical 意为“热带”，此处用 so tropical that 结构，说它热带到车站里没人敢靠近。
tropical 意为“热带”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的热带岛上的热带水果，等于最高级的说法。
tropical 意为“热带”，母亲认为这件东西“太热带了，谁也用不上”，too tropical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
tropical 意为“湿热”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩湿热的雨”，此处作前置定语 a tropical rain of the season。
tropical 意为“湿热”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩雨季湿热的雨一样湿热”，同级比较用 as tropical as。
tropical 意为“湿热”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“湿热的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something tropical。
tropical 意为“湿热”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当湿热”，quite 修饰原级 tropical。
tropical 意为“湿热”，no less tropical than 表示“其湿热不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之湿热不亚于任何人的预料。
tropical 意为“湿热”，母亲 1984 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的湿热雨”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件热带的水果。（a tropical fruit of the island）
它热带到车站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so tropical that …）
母亲觉得它太热带，谁也用不上。（too tropical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩湿热的雨。（a tropical rain of the season）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩雨季湿热的雨一样湿热。（as tropical as …）
到了 1979 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件湿热的东西。（something tropical）
answers: In 1972 the driver wrote of a tropical fruit of the island in the timetable.
It was so tropical that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too tropical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a tropical rain of the season.
He said nobody would call it as tropical as the rain of the season they had once had.
By 1979 the timetable asked for nothing but something tropical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 tropical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the driver wrote of a tropical fruit of the island in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the tropical fruit of the island that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too tropical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a tropical rain of the season, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite tropical, and everybody laughed.
The tropical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
